summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for profile navigation/logout and Google-auth additions on public preview URL. Critical account/profile bug is fixed: profile click keeps session and opens /account with wallet/menu visible. Google UI placement and invalid-code handling pass. One critical backend issue remains: auth CORS preflight still returns 400.

critical.issue: Preflight from https://dashboard-design-20.preview.emergentagent.com returns 400 (expected 200/204 with allow-origin + allow-credentials headers).

action_items: Fix backend CORS preflight for auth endpoints so browser credentialed requests are not blocked in strict clients.
After CORS fix, re-run browser auth smoke for login/logout/refresh and Google redirect start->callback exchange.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS config likely remains runtime-mismatched (explicit origin/regex not taking effect for OPTIONS), causing repeat regression across iterations.
Google callback flow safely handles missing code and invalid-code exchange (401) without backend 500.
Account sign-out is correctly scoped to account-signout-button; profile-link navigation no longer triggers logout side-effects.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ lockout customer via /api/auth/register during brute-force validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified with customer p0check_1790113956@example.com and admin deepak143 on preview URL. /account renders account-menu-panel and customer-wallet-balance on desktop and mobile (no horizontal clipping observed). /login shows google-signin-button for customer flow; /login?next=/admin hides it. /auth/google without code shows safe callback message + return-to-login. API POST /api/auth/google with invalid code returns 401. Admin login lands at /admin with .admin-shell visible.
rca of the issue: Repro: OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin=https://dashboard-design-20.preview.emergentagent.com + Access-Control-Request-Method=POST returns 400. Expected CORS middleware to allow configured preview origin with credentials. Probable root cause is origin matching/config application mismatch at runtime (middleware ordering/config value normalization/ingress interaction), not frontend behavior.
